name: ticket-desk
title: Ticket desk
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A ticket list with a status filter, a thread, a properties panel, and dialogs to create, edit, or delete a ticket.

meta.descriptionEs: Lista, hilo, propiedades y alta o edición de un encargo.

examples.title: Mesa de encargos
examples.description: El filtro de estado usa filter-toolbar. Una fecha pasada queda vencida.

meta.usage: <TicketDesk defaultTickets={tickets} agentName="Mateo" today="2026-10-06" statuses={statuses} priorities={priorities} types={types} channels={channels} assignees={people} />

api.name: today
api.description: Passed to ticket-properties so a past due date reads as overdue.

api.name: statuses / priorities / types
api.description: Options for the filter, the form, and the properties panel.

api.name: copy
api.description: Override the English chrome. Ticket text stays in your props.

docs: Clean-room ticket desk. Composes inbox-list, filter-toolbar, chat-message, reply-composer, ticket-properties, and entity-form. Pass tickets in. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
